data.author: davidlange6

data.title: Simcalohit add addMCParticleContribution
data.author: madbaron
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- Add `MutableSimCalorimeterHit::addMCParticleContribution`, which attaches a `CaloHitContribution` to the hit and adds its energy to the energy of the hit.
- Document that the energy of a `SimCalorimeterHit` is the sum of the energies of all its contributions, and that no time selection is applied to them. Time windows have to be handled by the digitization.

ENDRELEASENOTES

Using `addToContributions` alone leaves the hit energy untouched, which makes it easy to end up with a hit whose energy does not match its contributions when merging hits, e.g. in the `OverlayTiming` algorithm (key4hep/k4FWCore#443). The new method does both steps in one call. 

`addToContributions` is unchanged, and there is no change to the data layout, so no schema version bump is necessary.

data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Deep include chains (500 files) leaked RecursionError; they now raise IncludeError beyond 100 nested levels.

A directory symlink looping back (`loop -> .`) made the walker revisit the same physical file under ever longer lexical directories until the OS symlink limit; such re-entry is now skipped like any include cycle.

data.title: geometry: alias-aware overrides and symlink validation
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Fixes two alias-related materialization issues, on top of the include-alias fixes already on this branch.

- Changed `ref` attributes are resolved from every name (symlink) of the edited file, so resources and includes needed by each alias directory are copied and recorded in the manifest.
- Discovered symlink aliases are verified against the source before copying; a retargeted link raises `MaterializationError` and asks for rediscovery.

data.title: geometry: fingerprint aliases, aliased include traversal, manifest and YAML robustness
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
## Changes

- **Fingerprint:** include the effective file-alias mapping (catalog plus override-introduced), so geometries differing only in a symlink target no longer collide.
- **Include traversal:** a symlinked include in another directory is scanned again from its own directory, so its relative includes are discovered, copied and editable.
- **Manifest:** external references are listed once.
- **Config:** deeply nested YAML raises `ConfigError` instead of `RecursionError`.

data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Follow-ups from a fifth review pass; each finding was checked against the code first.

- `compute_fingerprint` takes the resource hashes `materialize` already verified instead of rehashing the source, so the fingerprint always describes the bytes that were published (and large CAD files are not hashed twice).
- The manifest keeps outside-root external references only for files still reachable in the edited snapshot.
